name: Netlify API
tagline: Jamstack hosting REST API for sites, deploys, forms, and edge functions
description: REST API for Netlify's platform: manage sites, deploys, builds, forms, edge functions, DNS, and account resources. Used for CI automation, programmatic site management, and integrating Netlify into developer tooling and agent workflows.

auth.details: Personal access token (OAuth or user token) sent as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY; create under User settings > Applications > Personal access tokens

pricing.free_tier_limits: 300 credits per month; this is a hard limit. When exhausted, all projects pause until the next billing cycle unless the account upgrades. Auto recharge is unavailable on Free.

rate_limits: Up to 500 requests per minute for most requests. Some operations have stricter limits; API deploys are limited to 3 per minute and 100 per day.
use_cases: list all sites on a Netlify account
trigger or inspect a site deploy
read form submissions for a Netlify form
manage DNS records for a Netlify domain
create or update environment variables for a site
check build and deploy status for CI automation
